title: qd
description: qd (SQS-compatible queue on Postgres): API, queues and runtime.

list.name: job
list.label: Installation (job)
list.description: Scrape job of the server pods. The scheduler pods of the same installation (job "<job>-scheduler", as created by the Helm chart ServiceMonitor) are included automatically.

panels.title: Ready API replicas
panels.description: Server (SQS API) replicas reporting qd_ready=1 (scheduler pods excluded; see the Scheduler row).

targets.expr: sum(qd_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?"} * on (namespace, job, instance) group_left () qd_build_info{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", role!="scheduler"})

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Versions currently running per role (more than one per role = rollout in progress or stuck).

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: Non-OK responses by AWS error code. InternalFailure/ServiceUnavailable are server-side (5xx); the rest are client errors.

targets.expr: max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_messages{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue", state="visible"})
max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_messages{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue", state="in_flight"})
max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_messages{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue", state="delayed"})
max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_oldest_message_age_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue"})

panels.title: Dead-letter queue depth
panels.description: Visible messages in queues that are the redrive target of another queue.

targets.expr: max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_messages{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue", state="visible"}) * on (account, queue) max by (account, queue) (qd_queue_info{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", account=~"$account", queue=~"$queue", is_dlq="true"})
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (queue, le) (rate(qd_message_size_bytes_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (queue, le) (rate(qd_message_size_bytes_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeat age
panels.description: Age of the freshest scheduler heartbeat, as seen by the API servers (QdSchedulerDown fires above 120s for 5m). No value = no heartbeat at all.

targets.expr: sum(qd_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?"} * on (namespace, job, instance) group_left () qd_build_info{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job(-scheduler)?", role="scheduler"})

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeat age (seen by servers)
panels.description: Max over server replicas. Grows linearly while no scheduler is running.

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeats written
panels.description: Heartbeat rows written per second by each scheduler replica (one every 10s when healthy).

panels.title: Message move tasks running
panels.description: Running DLQ redrive / message move tasks (executed by the scheduler pods).

panels.title: Messages expired / redriven
panels.description: Retention cleanup and redrive throughput of the scheduler.
